The Florida pipeline

We track 330 new developments across Florida — 118 under construction, 12 breaking ground, 38 opening soon, and 131 announced. Most active markets: Miami (87), West Palm Beach (60), Miami Beach (19), Naples (16), Fort Lauderdale (16). Specializing in: Residences (176), Mixed-Use (79), Entertainment (14).

How we built this list

Every project on this page is on the Map of Tomorrow — our live database of new and under-construction developments worldwide. Project status, milestones, and spec changes are sourced from public filings, official announcements, or independent reporting and timestamped. Pro members get the TMW Forecast on every project and the full Florida dataset by phase, neighborhood, and developer.
